metrics.query: cve_records WHERE attributed_to = 'quillmark-labs' AND state = 'PUBLISHED' AND datePublished IN (2024-10-06T12:00:00.000Z, 2026-10-06T12:00:00Z] AND id NOT IN exclusions -> containers.cna.problemTypes[].descriptions[].cweId (placeholders counted: false)

cve_records WHERE attributed_to = 'quillmark-labs' AND state = 'PUBLISHED' AND datePublished IN (2024-10-06T12:00:00.000Z, 2026-10-06T12:00:00Z] AND id NOT IN exclusions -> containers.cna.affected[].cpes[] + containers.cna.cpeApplicability[].nodes[].cpeMatch[].criteria (well-formed CPE 2.3)

cve_records WHERE attributed_to = 'quillmark-labs' AND state = 'PUBLISHED' AND datePublished IN (2024-10-06T12:00:00.000Z, 2026-10-06T12:00:00Z] AND id NOT IN exclusions AND has_wellformed_cna_cpe -> cpe.vendor IN cpe_vendor_aliases('quillmark-labs') = [quillmark]

cve_records WHERE attributed_to = 'quillmark-labs' AND state = 'PUBLISHED' AND datePublished IN (2024-10-06T12:00:00.000Z, 2026-10-06T12:00:00Z] AND id NOT IN exclusions -> cna.cwe usable AND cna.cpe well-formed AND cpe.vendor IN cpe_vendor_aliases('quillmark-labs')

cve_records WHERE attributed_to = 'quillmark-labs' AND state = 'PUBLISHED' AND datePublished IN (2024-10-06T12:00:00.000Z, 2026-10-06T12:00:00Z] AND id NOT IN exclusions AND (NOT cna.cwe usable OR NOT cna.cpe well-formed) -> containers.adp[] supplies the missing field
attribution_exclusions WHERE reason = 'DUPLICATE_CONFLICT' AND 'quillmark-labs' IN candidateVendorIds
metrics.calculation: 3 CVE id(s) with conflicting duplicate records.

metrics.query: advisories WHERE vendorId = 'quillmark-labs' AND severity IN (CRITICAL, HIGH) AND publishedAt IN (2024-10-06T12:00:00.000Z, 2026-10-06T12:00:00Z] -> cveIds[] EXISTS IN cve_records (state PUBLISHED)

advisories WHERE vendorId = 'quillmark-labs' AND severity IN (CRITICAL, HIGH) AND publishedAt IN (2024-10-06T12:00:00.000Z, 2026-10-06T12:00:00Z] -> max(cve.datePublished) - advisory.publishedAt <= 1 days (methodology parameter timelinessToleranceDays)

advisories WHERE vendorId = 'quillmark-labs' AND severity IN (CRITICAL, HIGH) AND publishedAt IN (2024-10-06T12:00:00.000Z, 2026-10-06T12:00:00Z] -> max(cve.datePublished) - advisory.publishedAt, in days (sign kept)
